name: TicksFile
summary: This EA is a data-logging utility that records tick data and bar data to a CSV file in real time. It captures completed bar OHLCV data alongside incoming tick details (ask, bid, last, volume) and writes them to a timestamped file. It does not open, manage, or close any trading positions.
summary_zh: 这是一个数据记录工具EA，实时将tick数据和K线数据写入CSV文件。它捕获已完成K线的OHLCV数据以及到达的tick详情（ask、bid、last、volume），写入带时间戳的文件中。该EA不进行任何开仓、管理或平仓操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个纯粹的数据采集工具。其核心功能是在每次tick到达时，将已完成K线的开高低收成交量数据与当前tick的报价信息一并写入CSV文件，供后续离线分析使用。入场条件方面，当diskret参数为true时，仅在新K线开盘时才记录数据，实现降采样；为false时则每个tick都记录。出场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理与资金管理均不涉及。该工具的价值在于为量化研究提供高质量的逐tick历史数据，便于策略回测和统计分析。其文件命名规则包含品种、周期和起始时间，便于数据管理。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a pure data collection utility. Its core function is to write completed bar OHLCV data alongside incoming tick quote information (ask, bid, last, volume) to a CSV file on each tick arrival for offline analysis. Regarding entry conditions, when the diskret parameter is true, it only records data at new bar openings for downsampling; when false, it records every tick. Exit conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trading operations. Position sizing and money management are not involved whatsoever. The utility's value lies in providing high-quality tick-by-tick historical data for quantitative research, facilitating strategy backtesting and statistical analysis. Its file naming convention includes symbol, timeframe, and start time, which facilitates data management and organization.

parameters.name: diskret
parameters.description: 是否仅在K线开盘时记录数据，true为降采样模式
parameters.description_en: Record data only on bar open; downsampling mode

parameters.name: Filler
parameters.description: CSV文件中的字段分隔符，若输入空格则自动替换为制表符
parameters.description_en: CSV field separator; space auto-replaced with tab

pros: 提供逐tick级别的高精度数据记录，适合量化研究
支持降采样模式（diskret=true），可按K线周期记录以减少数据量
文件名自动包含品种、周期和时间信息，便于数据归档与检索
pros_en: Provides tick-level high-precision data recording suitable for quantitative research
Supports downsampling mode (diskret=true) to record by bar period and reduce data volume
File names automatically include symbol, timeframe, and time info for easy archiving and retrieval
cons: 无文件写入错误处理，若FileOpen失败后仍继续调用FileWrite可能导致异常
缺少文件大小监控，长时间运行可能生成超大文件导致磁盘空间不足
FileOpen返回值检查有误（hF<-1），正确应为hF==INVALID_HANDLE即hF<0
cons_en: No file write error handling; if FileOpen fails, subsequent FileWrite calls may cause undefined behavior
No file size monitoring; long-running sessions may generate extremely large files exhausting disk space
FileOpen return value check is incorrect (hF<-1); should be hF==INVALID_HANDLE which is hF<0
improvements: 修正FileOpen返回值检查逻辑，应使用hF==INVALID_HANDLE进行判断
增加文件大小限制或自动分割机制，避免单个文件过大
增加SymbolInfoTick和CopyRates失败时的重试机制
improvements_en: Fix FileOpen return value check logic; should use hF==INVALID_HANDLE for validation
Add file size limit or auto-split mechanism to prevent excessively large single files
Add retry mechanism for SymbolInfoTick and CopyRates failures

risk_points: FileOpen返回值检查逻辑错误，可能在文件打开失败时继续写入导致未定义行为
长时间运行无文件大小控制，存在磁盘空间耗尽风险
risk_points_en: FileOpen return value check logic error may cause undefined behavior if file open fails and writes continue
No file size control during long-running sessions poses disk space exhaustion risk
